acceptanceCriteria: The artifact and evidence files exist and validate.
A nonzero exit is accepted only for SFHS_RELEASE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_REQUIRED.
The result reports profile, session/run ID, commit, artifact SHA-256, build ID, and evidence paths.
stopConditions: Stop with SFHS_HERMES_REPOSITORY_MISMATCH if root, branch, base commit, or cleanliness differs.
Stop with SFHS_HERMES_SCOPE_VIOLATION before any write outside allowedFiles.
Stop with SFHS_HERMES_COMMAND_FAILED for an undeclared exit code or unexpected blocker.
Never release, push, publish, deploy, or change a Hermes profile.
nextAction: Run the single declared command, then report the bounded builder result.
